name: Filmic Muzzle Flash & Specular Halation
purpose: Recreate authentic optical film halation around bright muzzle bursts, sun reflections and sparks.
required_visual_conditions: Pixel luminance exceeding 85 IRE (pure white cores).
fusion_node_structure: MediaIn1 -> LumaKeyer1 (Threshold: 0.8) -> Blur1 (Radius: 8) -> ColorCorrector1 (Tint: Red-Orange) -> Merge1 (Screen) over MediaIn1
resolve_implementation_instructions: Fusion Page or Glow Expo: Apply threshold glow with warm red-orange tint to highlight fringes.
qa_procedure: Check that halation does not turn entire weapon red; confine to specular fringe pixels.
